summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist, which follows the six-step workflow and raises ValueError for all validation failures. Added the explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities entry, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp dirs cleaned via addCleanup). Nothing was run: no tests, black, or repo code. Formatting and the 120-column limit were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed. Choices: malformed JSON is re-raised as ValueError with the file name; a non-list value under the data list key is rejected with ValueError.
